statement: NSE Clearing Limited (NCL) settlement holidays, Capital Market segment 'CM', calendar year 2026, as served by the clearing-holiday data endpoint of https://www.nseindia.com/resources/exchange-communication-holidays. NSE's settlement-cycle page: 'For arriving at the settlement day all intervening holidays, which include bank holidays, NSE holidays, Saturdays and Sundays are excluded.' No 2027 list was published on 2026-10-22, so the horizon ends on 2026-12-31.

sources.covers: NCL/CMPT/71904 of 2025-12-22 (circular 394/2025): 'CM - Settlement Holidays for the Calendar Year 2026' (19 weekday holidays; 15 January 2026 was added later and is in the live list)
'NSE Clearing follows a T+1/ T+0 rolling settlement cycle' and the rule that bank holidays, NSE holidays, Saturdays and Sundays are excluded
NCL/CMPT/77037 of 2026-10-21: trades of Muhurat Sunday 2026-11-08 and of Friday 2026-11-06 settle on Monday 2026-11-09; trades of 2026-11-09 settle on 2026-11-11

notes: Settlement calendar only: it says nothing about trading. 2026-02-19, 2026-03-19, 2026-04-01 and 2026-08-26 are NSE trading days but NCL settlement holidays.
Weekend settlement holidays listed in NCL/CMPT/71904 (2026-02-15, 2026-03-21, 2026-08-15, 2026-11-08) are weekends and need no entry.
The Muhurat session (Sunday 2026-11-08) is a trade date, not a settlement day; T+1 from it lands on Monday 2026-11-09, matching NCL/CMPT/77037.
NSE's terms of use prohibit systematic automated collection from its website; refresh by a manual, owner-approved retrieval.
